title: Which Harry Potter Character Are You?
description: Answer 12 questions to discover your Harry Potter character!

questions.text: How do you spend a free afternoon at Hogwarts?

options.text: Practice potion-making in the dungeons alone
Lead a group game of wizard chess in the common room
Tinker with a new spell idea you’ve been imagining
Organize your herbology notes for next week’s class

questions.text: When solving a difficult spell, you…

options.text: Adapt your approach based on how the wand feels in your hand
Follow the textbook instructions step-by-step
Focus on how the spell could help a friend in need
Analyze the spell’s mechanics to understand its weaknesses

questions.text: Preparing for a Quidditch match, you…

options.text: Mentally map out plays while sitting alone in the stands
Brainstorm wild new tactics with the team
Drill basic moves until they’re second nature
Fire up the team with a rousing speech before takeoff

questions.text: You find a mysterious locket in the Forbidden Forest. You…

options.text: Take it to Dumbledore immediately—rules exist for safety
Keep it to examine later, curious about its hidden magic
Wonder if it belonged to someone who’s lost it, and try to return it
Study its engravings to deduce its origin and purpose
Ancient Runes—you’re drawn to its symbolic, hidden meanings
Care of Magical Creatures—you love hands-on interaction
Divination—you want to explore what the future holds
Muggle Studies—you enjoy learning practical, real-world facts

questions.text: A housemate borrows your favorite book and damages it. You…

options.text: Tell them calmly why it upset you and ask them to be more careful
Brush it off—accidents happen, and you don’t want to argue
Set a clear rule: no borrowing without asking first
Laugh it off and suggest you fix it together later
Wander alone through the Shrieking Shack, curious about its stories
Meet friends at The Three Broomsticks for butterbeer and gossip
Hunt for rare sweets at Honeydukes—you love trying new flavors
Explore the edge of the village, hoping to find a hidden path

questions.text: A Ravenclaw riddle stumps you. You…

options.text: Let your mind wander, trusting a sudden insight will hit
Break it down into parts and solve it step by step
Ask others for their thoughts—collaboration sparks ideas
Logic it out: what’s the pattern or hidden meaning?

questions.text: A classmate pranks you by turning your hair green. You…

options.text: Laugh and plan a clever retaliation after class
Roll your eyes and fix it quietly—no need for drama
Admire their creativity—green actually suits you!
Grab a hair charm from your bag and fix it immediately
Study alone in the library, focusing on memorizing facts
Form a study group to quiz each other and share notes
Understand the ‘why’ behind spells, not just the ‘how’
Practice wand movements until you can cast them blindfolded

questions.text: Choosing a pet at Diagon Alley, you pick…

options.text: A calm cat that curls up with you while you read
A playful owl that greets everyone who enters the shop
A loyal toad—practical, low-maintenance, and reliable
A mysterious kneazle—you’re drawn to its unusual aura
Stick to the battle plan you memorized with the Order
Trust your instincts and react to their moves in the moment
Charge in to protect your friends, even if it’s risky
Assess their weaknesses and plan a strategic counterattack

results.title: Harry Potter
results.description: You’re brave, action-oriented, and deeply loyal—just like the Boy Who Lived. You thrive in the moment, face danger head-on to protect others, and value friendship above all. Your quick thinking and willingness to adapt make you a natural leader, even when you don’t seek the role. You’re an ESFP—bold, energetic, and always ready to fight for what’s right.

results.title: Hermione Granger
results.description: You’re a brilliant strategist with a mind for details and a passion for learning. Like Hermione, you value logic, plan meticulously, and believe in doing what’s right—even when it’s hard. You’re organized, determined, and unafraid to speak your mind. Your INTJ traits make you a problem-solver who turns knowledge into action, inspiring others with your wisdom.

results.title: Ron Weasley
results.description: Warm, loyal, and always ready to stand by your friends, you’re the heart of any group—just like Ron. You thrive on connection, hate letting people down, and bring humor to even the darkest moments. Your ESFJ nature makes you a natural caretaker, quick to comfort and support, and your loyalty is unshakable, even when faced with doubt.

results.title: Albus Dumbledore
results.description: Wise, charismatic, and driven by a vision of a better world, you’re a natural leader like Dumbledore. You see the big picture, inspire others with your optimism, and believe in the power of love and redemption. Your ENFJ traits make you a master at bringing people together, turning enemies into allies, and guiding others toward their potential.

results.title: Severus Snape
results.description: Complex, intuitive, and fiercely protective, you guard your emotions but care deeply—just like Snape. You see beyond surface appearances, hold onto long-buried truths, and act with quiet purpose. Your INFJ nature makes you a keeper of secrets, driven by a personal mission that others may not understand until the end.

results.title: Ginny Weasley
results.description: Confident, bold, and unapologetically yourself, you’re a force to be reckoned with—like Ginny. You thrive in action, love a good challenge, and aren’t afraid to take risks. Your ESTP traits make you adaptable, quick-witted, and always ready to jump into the fray, whether it’s Quidditch or a fight against dark magic.

results.title: Luna Lovegood
results.description: Creative, idealistic, and wonderfully unique, you see the world through a different lens—just like Luna. You value imagination, trust your intuition, and stay true to yourself, even when others mock your quirks. Your INFP nature makes you a dreamer with a kind heart, finding beauty in the unusual and hope in the darkest times.

results.title: Draco Malfoy
results.description: Ambitious, structured, and driven by a desire to prove yourself, you’re a complex mix of pride and vulnerability—like Draco. You value tradition, strive for success, and hate feeling weak. Your ESTJ traits make you decisive and organized, though deep down, you’re still figuring out where your true loyalties lie.

results.title: Neville Longbottom
results.description: Gentle, loyal, and quietly brave, you grow stronger with time—just like Neville. You’re patient, dependable, and willing to stand up for what’s right, even when you’re scared. Your ISFP nature makes you practical yet kind, finding strength in small acts of courage and loyalty to those you love.

results.title: Sirius Black
results.description: Witty, rebellious, and full of life, you’re a free spirit who defies expectations—like Sirius. You hate rules that stifle joy, love a good prank, and would die for your friends. Your ENTP traits make you clever, quick-thinking, and unafraid to challenge the status quo, even when it lands you in trouble.

results.title: Remus Lupin
results.description: Thoughtful, analytical, and deeply kind, you balance wisdom with humility—just like Lupin. You love learning, adapt easily to new situations, and have a knack for seeing the best in people. Your INTP nature makes you a quiet problem-solver, using logic and empathy to guide others through tough times.

results.title: Bellatrix Lestrange
results.description: Dominant, strategic, and unyielding in your beliefs, you’re a force of intensity—like Bellatrix. You pursue your goals with ruthless determination, thrive on power, and refuse to back down. Your ENTJ traits make you a natural leader, though your loyalty to a dark cause blinds you to the cost of your actions.

results.title: Minerva McGonagall
results.description: Disciplined, responsible, and fiercely protective, you’re a pillar of strength—just like McGonagall. You value order, expect excellence, and care deeply for those under your charge. Your ISFJ nature makes you a steady presence, balancing strictness with kindness, and always ready to defend what’s good.

results.title: Fred Weasley
results.description: Energetic, creative, and the life of the party, you turn every moment into an adventure—like Fred. You love making people laugh, thrive on collaboration, and see the world as a playground for ideas. Your ENFP traits make you a visionary prankster, turning ordinary days into unforgettable memories.

results.title: George Weasley
results.description: Practical, quick-witted, and a master of execution, you turn ideas into reality—like George. You’re the hands-on half of any duo, solving problems with a smirk and a clever invention. Your ISTP nature makes you adaptable, resourceful, and always ready to pivot when a prank (or plan) goes sideways.

results.title: Cedric Diggory
results.description: Honest, reliable, and quietly confident, you embody dignity and sportsmanship—just like Cedric. You play by the rules, treat others with respect, and rise to challenges with grace. Your ISTJ nature makes you a steady leader, earning trust through consistency and integrity, even in the face of adversity.
